summary: The diff implements fixes across backend/main.mo, BookingForm.tsx, and useQueries.ts covering the three requirements. The backend now includes preferredTime in BookingRequest, returns a Result variant (#ok/#err), and the frontend hook unwraps the variant. BookingForm.tsx adds WhatsApp and email notification buttons post-submission. However, there is one concern with the hook's variant unwrapping logic using result.__kind__ which is non-standard for Candid/ICP agent JS bindings. Overall coverage is strong with minor uncertainties.

missing_requirements.requirement: On failure, display 'Booking failed. Please check your details and try again.'
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows BookingForm.tsx is truncated and the error message text 'Booking failed. Please check your details and try again.' is not confirmed to be present. The hook throws a BookingSubmissionError with a different message ('Invalid input provided.' or 'An internal error occurred.'), and it is unclear whether BookingForm.tsx maps this to the required user-facing error string.

missing_requirements.requirement: The useCreateBooking hook throws or rejects with an error message when the backend returns an #err variant.
missing_requirements.reason: The hook uses result.__kind__ === 'ok' to unwrap the variant, which is not the standard pattern used by the ICP JS agent (which typically uses 'ok' in result). This may not correctly detect the #err case, potentially failing to throw BookingSubmissionError when the backend returns an error variant.

hallucinated_features.description: WhatsApp message includes emoji decorations and a footer line 'Please confirm this booking at your earliest convenience.'
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request specifies the WhatsApp message should include booking details prefixed with 'New Booking from Website' but does not request emoji decorations or the specific footer line.

hallucinated_features.description: Email body includes 'Please log in to the admin dashboard to confirm this booking.' footer line
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request specifies the email body should contain all booking details but does not request this specific admin instruction footer line.
